mapper.select: SELECT `image_data` FROM `cors`.`item_review_images` WHERE `review_id` = #{reviewId} ORDER BY `id` ASC
SELECT ri.`image_data` FROM `cors`.`item_review_images` AS ri INNER JOIN `cors`.`item_reviews` AS ir ON ri.`review_id` = ir.`id` WHERE ir.`item_id` = #{itemId} ORDER BY ri.`id` DESC

SELECT IFNULL((SELECT r.`id` FROM `cors`.`reservations` AS r INNER JOIN `cors`.`reservation_items` AS ri ON r.`id` = ri.`reservation_id` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`item_reviews` AS ir ON r.`id` = ir.`reservation_id` WHERE r.`user_email` = #{email} AND ri.`item_id` = #{itemId} AND r.`status` = '확정' AND ir.`id` IS NULL LIMIT 1), 0)

SELECT `id` AS `id`, `item_id` AS `itemId`, `shop_id` AS `shopId`, `user_email` AS `userEmail`, `reservation_id` AS `reservationId`, `content` AS `content`, `rating` AS `rating`, `useful_count` AS `usefulCount`, `created_at` AS `createdAt`, `updated_at` AS `updatedAt` FROM `cors`.`item_reviews` WHERE `id` = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.`id` FROM `cors`.`reservations` AS r INNER JOIN `cors`.`reservation_items` AS ri ON r.`id` = ri.`reservation_id` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`item_reviews` AS ir ON r.`id` = ir.`reservation_id` WHERE r.`user_email` = #{email} AND ri.`item_id` = CAST(#{itemId} AS UNSIGNED) AND r.`status` LIKE '%확정%' AND ir.`id` IS NULL ORDER BY r.`id` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL((SELECT `review_id` FROM `cors`.`item_review_likes` WHERE `review_id` = #{reviewId} AND `user_email` = #{email} LIMIT 1), 0)

SELECT c.`id` AS `id`, c.`review_id` AS `reviewId`, c.`user_email` AS `userEmail`, u.`name` AS `userName`, c.`content` AS `content`, c.`parent_id` AS `parentId`, c.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, c.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt` FROM `cors`.`item_review_comments` AS c LEFT JOIN `cors`.`users` AS u ON c.`user_email` = u.`email` WHERE c.`review_id` = #{reviewId} ORDER BY IFNULL(c.`parent_id`, c.`id`) ASC, c.`created_at` ASC

SELECT `id` AS `id`, `review_id` AS `reviewId`, `user_email` AS `userEmail`, `content` AS `content`, `parent_id` AS `parentId`, `created_at` AS `createdAt`, `updated_at` AS `updatedAt` FROM `cors`.`item_review_comments` WHERE `id` = #{id} LIMIT 1
